catenaShort: Quoted verbatim from the Church Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church — chiefly St John Chrysostom and Blessed Theophylact of Ohrid. Each quotation above names its own Father and the homily or work it is drawn from.
catenaLong: The patristic commentary quoted throughout is drawn from the Church Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church, led by St John Chrysostom and Blessed Theophylact of Ohrid, whose commentary on the Gospels is the standard Orthodox reading of them — quoted verbatim, nothing paraphrased and nothing invented; each quotation names its own Father and the homily or work it comes from.
